description: This source file contains implementation of metal-based binary elementwise operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) for PyTorch tensors, utilizing Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) on iOS devices. It includes functions for input validation, broadcasting, and kernel execution, and registers these operations with the PyTorch ATen library under the 'Metal' backend.
